# Default collation applies to future STRING fields, including nested ones, but an explicit
# empty collation overrides it. ALTER changes only the default, never existing fields.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/collation-concepts.md
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/data-definition-language.md
CREATE TEMP TABLE t (c STRING, b STRING COLLATE '') DEFAULT COLLATE 'und:ci';
INSERT t VALUES ('a', 'a');
SELECT c = 'A' AND NOT (b = 'A') FROM t
=> "true"

CREATE TEMP TABLE t (s STRUCT<f STRING, b STRING COLLATE ''>, a ARRAY<STRING>, n INT64) DEFAULT COLLATE 'und:ci';
INSERT t VALUES (STRUCT('a', 'a'), ['a'], 1);
SELECT s.f = 'A' AND NOT (s.b = 'A') AND a[OFFSET(0)] = 'A' AND n = 1 FROM t
=> "true"

CREATE TEMP TABLE t (c STRING) DEFAULT COLLATE 'und:ci';
ALTER TABLE t SET DEFAULT COLLATE '';
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN b STRING;
INSERT t VALUES ('a', 'a');
SELECT c = 'A' AND NOT (b = 'A') FROM t
=> "true"

CREATE TEMP TABLE t (b STRING);
ALTER TABLE t SET DEFAULT COLLATE 'und:ci';
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN c STRING;
INSERT t VALUES ('a', 'a');
SELECT NOT (b = 'A') AND c = 'A' FROM t
=> "true"

CREATE TEMP TABLE t (c STRING) DEFAULT COLLATE 'und:ci';
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN b STRING COLLATE '';
INSERT t VALUES ('a', 'a');
SELECT c = 'A' AND NOT (b = 'A') FROM t
=> "true"

CREATE TEMP TABLE t (c STRING) DEFAULT COLLATE 'und:ci';
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN s STRUCT<f STRING, b STRING COLLATE ''>;
INSERT t VALUES ('a', STRUCT('a', 'a'));
SELECT c = 'A' AND s.f = 'A' AND NOT (s.b = 'A') FROM t
=> "true"
